pob.text: But they[a], our fathers, acted presumptuously and stiffened their neck[c][b], and did not listen to your commandments.

spob.text: But our fathers acted proudly and defiantly. They stiffened their necks in stubborn rebellion and would not listen to your commandments.

public_domain_references.bsb: But they and our fathers became arrogant and stiff-necked and did not obey Your commandments.
public_domain_references.web: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,
public_domain_references.asv: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their neck, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
public_domain_references.kjv: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
public_domain_references.brenton: But they and our fathers behaved proudly, and hardened their neck, and did not hearken to thy commandments,

pob.text: But they refused to listen and did not remember your wonders that you had done among them[a]. They stiffened their neck and appointed a leader to return to their slavery in their rebellion. But you are a God of forgiveness, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abundant in steadfast love[b], and you did not forsake them.

spob.text: But they refused to listen. They forgot the wonders you had done among them. In their rebellion, they stubbornly stiffened their necks and appointed a leader to take them back into slavery. But you are a God whose forgiveness is abundant.[a] You are gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abundant in steadfast love, and you did not abandon them.

public_domain_references.bsb: They refused to listen and failed to remember the wonders You performed among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed a leader to return them to their bondage in Egypt. But You are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion, and You did not forsake them.
public_domain_references.web: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.
public_domain_references.asv: and refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, and forsookest them not.
public_domain_references.kjv: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou [art] a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
public_domain_references.brenton: and refused to listen, and remembered not thy wonders which thou wroughtest with them; and they hardened their neck, and appointed a leader to return to their slavery in Egypt: but thou, O God, [art] merciful and compassionate, long-suffering, and abundant in mercy, and thou didst not forsake them.

pob.text: Even when they made for themselves a cast metal calf and said[a], ‘This is your god who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and committed great blasphemies[b],

spob.text: Even when they made a calf-shaped metal idol for themselves and said, “This is your god who brought you up out of Egypt,” they committed great blasphemies,

public_domain_references.bsb: Even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and when they committed terrible blasphemies,
public_domain_references.web: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,
public_domain_references.asv: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
public_domain_references.kjv: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This [is] thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
public_domain_references.brenton: And still farther they even made to themselves a molten calf, and said, These [are] the gods that brought us up out of Egypt: and they wrought great provocations.

pob.text: But you[a], in your abundant mercies, did not abandon them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud did not depart from above them by day, to lead them on the way, nor the pillar of fire by night, to give them light and the way in which they should go.

spob.text: But because your mercies[a] are so abundant, you did not abandon them in the wilderness. By day, the pillar of cloud remained above them to lead them on the way. By night, the pillar of fire remained above them to give them light and to light the way they were to go.

public_domain_references.bsb: You in Your great compassion did not forsake them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud never turned away from guiding them on their path; and by the night the pillar of fire illuminated the way they should go.
public_domain_references.web: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.
public_domain_references.asv: yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of cloud departed not from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way wherein they should go.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
public_domain_references.brenton: Yet thou in thy great compassions didst not forsake them in the wilderness: thou didst not turn away from them the pillar of the cloud by day, to guide them in the way, nor the pillar of fire by night, to enlighten for them the way wherein they should walk.

pob.text: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them[a], and you did not withhold your manna from their mouth, and you gave them water for their thirst.

spob.text: You gave them your good Spirit to teach them. You did not keep your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water when they were thirsty.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold Your manna from their mouths, and You gave them water for their thirst.
public_domain_references.web: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou gavest also thy good Spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou gavest thy good Spirit to instruct them, and thou didst not withhold thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water in their thirst.

pob.text: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness[a]; they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out[b], and their feet did not swell.

spob.text: For forty years, you provided for them in the wilderness, and they had everything they needed. Their clothes did not wear out, and their feet did not swell.

public_domain_references.bsb: For forty years You sustained them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.
public_domain_references.web: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.
public_domain_references.asv: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, [and] they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, [so that] they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou didst sustain them forty years in the wilderness; thou didst not allow anything to fail them: their garments did not wax old, and their feet were not bruised.

pob.text: You gave them kingdoms and peoples, and allotted them to every corner. So they took possession of the land of Sihon, that is, the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

spob.text: You gave them kingdoms and peoples and allotted them among the regions. So they took possession of the land of Sihon, king of Heshbon, and the land of Og, king of Bashan.

public_domain_references.bsb: You gave them kingdoms and peoples and allotted to them every corner of the land. So they took the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and of Og king of Bashan.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
public_domain_references.asv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and peoples, which thou didst allot after their portions: so they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
public_domain_references.brenton: Moreover, thou gavest them kingdoms, and didst divide nations to them: and they inherited the land of Seon king of Esebon, and the land of Og king of Basan.

pob.text: You multiplied their children like the stars of the heavens[c][b][a], and you brought them into the land that you had told their fathers to enter and possess.

spob.text: You made their children as numerous as the stars in the heavens. You brought them into the land you had told their fathers to enter and possess.

public_domain_references.bsb: You multiplied their descendants like the stars of heaven and brought them to the land You had told their fathers to enter and possess.
public_domain_references.web: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.
public_domain_references.asv: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land concerning which thou didst say to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
public_domain_references.kjv: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess [it].
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou didst multiply their children as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land of which thou spokest to their fathers;

pob.text: So the sons came in and took possession of the land[a], and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hand, both their kings and the peoples of the land[c][b], to do with them according to their will.

spob.text: Then their sons entered the land and took possession of it. You subdued the people living there—the Canaanites—and gave them into the sons’ power, along with their kings and the peoples of the land. The sons could deal with them as they pleased.

public_domain_references.bsb: So their descendants went in and possessed the land; You subdued before them the Canaanites dwelling in the land. You delivered into their hands the kings and peoples of the land, to do with them as they wished.
public_domain_references.web: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.
public_domain_references.asv: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
public_domain_references.kjv: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they inherited it: and thou didst destroy from before them the dwellers in the land of the Chananites, and thou gavest into their hands them and their kings, and the nations of the land, to do unto them as it pleased them.

pob.text: They captured fortified cities and fertile land[a], and took possession of houses full of every good thing, hewn cisterns, vineyards, olive trees, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled and grew fat[c][b], and they delighted themselves in your great goodness.

spob.text: They captured fortified cities and fertile land. They took possession of houses filled with every good thing, carved water-storage pits, vineyards, olive trees, and fruit trees in abundance. They ate their fill and grew fat.[a] They delighted in your great goodness.

public_domain_references.bsb: They captured fortified cities and fertile land and took houses full of all goods, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled; they grew fat and delighted in Your great goodness.
public_domain_references.web: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.
public_domain_references.asv: And they took fortified cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns hewn out, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit-trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they took lofty cities, and inherited houses full of all good things, wells dug, vineyards, and oliveyards, and every fruit tree in abundance: so they ate, and were filled, and grew fat, and rioted in thy great goodness.

pob.text: But they acted presumptuously and rebelled against you[a], and they cast your law behind their backs. They killed your prophets, who had warned them in order to bring them back to you[d][c][b], and they committed great blasphemies.

spob.text: But they acted defiantly and rebelled against you. They threw your law behind their backs. They killed your prophets, who had warned them so that they would return to you. They committed grave acts of blasphemy.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: But they were disobedient and rebelled against You; they flung Your law behind their backs. They killed Your prophets, who had admonished them to return to You. They committed terrible blasphemies.
public_domain_references.web: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.
public_domain_references.asv: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their back, and slew thy prophets that testified against them to turn them again unto thee, and they wrought great provocations.
public_domain_references.kjv: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
public_domain_references.brenton: But they turned, and revolted from thee, and cast thy law behind their backs; and they slew thy prophets, who testified against them to turn them back to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

pob.text: So you gave them into the hand of their adversaries[a], who oppressed them. But in the time of their distress they cried out to you, and you heard from heaven; and according to your abundant mercies you gave them deliverers, who saved them from the hand of their adversaries.

spob.text: So you handed them over to the power of their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they were in distress, they cried out to you. You heard them from heaven, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers,[a] who saved them from the power of their enemies.

public_domain_references.bsb: So You delivered them into the hands of enemies who oppressed them, and in their time of distress they cried out to You. From heaven You heard them, and in Your great compassion You gave them deliverers who saved them from the hands of their enemies.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours who saved them out of the hand of their adversaries.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest [them] from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
public_domain_references.brenton: Then thou gavest them into the hand of them that afflicted them, and they did afflict them: and they cried to thee in the time of their affliction, and thou didst hear them from thy heaven, and in thy great compassions gavest them deliverers, and didst save them from the hand of them that afflicted them.

pob.text: But as soon as they had rest[a], they turned back to do evil before you, and you abandoned them into the hand of their enemies, who ruled over them. Then they turned back and cried out to you[c][b], and you heard from heaven and delivered them many times according to your abundant mercies.

spob.text: But as soon as they had relief,[a] they returned to doing evil before you. So you abandoned them to the power of their enemies, who ruled over them. Then they turned back and cried out to you. You heard from heaven and delivered them many times, in keeping with your abundant mercies.

public_domain_references.bsb: But as soon as they had rest, they again did evil in Your sight. So You abandoned them to the hands of their enemies, who had dominion over them. When they cried out to You again, You heard from heaven, and You delivered them many times in Your compassion.
public_domain_references.web: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,
public_domain_references.asv: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee; therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies,
public_domain_references.kjv: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest [them] from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
public_domain_references.brenton: But when they rested, they did evil again before thee: so thou leftest them in the hands of their enemies, and they ruled over them: and they cried again to thee, and thou heardest [them] from heaven, and didst deliver them in thy great compassions.

pob.text: You warned them in order to bring them back to your law[a], but they acted presumptuously and did not listen to your commandments; they sinned against your judgments, by which a man shall live if he does them. They gave a stubborn shoulder, stiffened their neck[b], and would not listen.

spob.text: You warned them so that they would return to your law. But they acted in arrogant defiance and did not listen to your commandments. They sinned against your judgments—the judgments by which a man who obeys them will live.[a][b] They turned a stubborn shoulder and stiffened their necks; they refused to listen.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: You admonished them to turn back to Your law, but they were arrogant and disobeyed Your commandments. They sinned against Your ordinances, by which a man will live if he practices them. They stubbornly shrugged their shoulders; they stiffened their necks and would not obey.
public_domain_references.web: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.
public_domain_references.asv: and testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law. Yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thine ordinances (which if a man do, he shall live in them), and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
public_domain_references.kjv: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou didst testify against them, to bring them back to thy law: but they hearkened not, but sinned against thy commandments and thy judgments, which if a man do, he shall live in them; and they turned their back, and hardened their neck, and heard not.

pob.text: For many years you were patient with them and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets[a], but they would not listen. So you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

spob.text: For many years you were patient with them. You warned them[a] by your Spirit through your prophets, but they refused to listen. So you handed them over to the power of peoples from other lands.

public_domain_references.bsb: You were patient with them for many years, and Your Spirit admonished them through Your prophets. Yet they would not listen, so You gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.
public_domain_references.web: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
public_domain_references.asv: Yet many years didst thou bear with them, and testifiedst against them by thy Spirit through thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
public_domain_references.brenton: Yet thou didst bear long with them many years, and didst testify to them by thy Spirit by the hand of thy prophets: but they hearkened not; so thou gavest them into the hand of the nations of the land.

pob.text: But in your abundant mercies you did not make an end of them or abandon them[a], for you are a gracious and compassionate God.

spob.text: But in your abundant mercy, you did not completely destroy them or abandon them, because you are a gracious and compassionate God.

public_domain_references.bsb: But in Your great compassion, You did not put an end to them; nor did You forsake them, for You are a gracious and compassionate God.
public_domain_references.web: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.
public_domain_references.asv: Nevertheless in thy manifold mercies thou didst not make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
public_domain_references.kjv: Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou [art] a gracious and merciful God.
public_domain_references.brenton: But thou in thy many mercies didst not appoint them to destruction, and didst not forsake them; for thou art strong, and merciful, and pitiful.

pob.text: And now[a], our God—the great, mighty, and fearsome God, who keeps the covenant and steadfast love—do not let all the hardship that has come upon us seem small before you: upon our kings, our officials, our priests, our prophets, our fathers[b], and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until this day.

spob.text: And now, our God, you are the great, mighty, and fearsome God.[a] You keep your covenant and show steadfast love. Please do not consider all the hardship that has come upon us a small matter. It has fallen on our kings and officials, our priests and prophets, our fathers,[b] and all your people, from the time of the kings of Assyria until today.

public_domain_references.bsb: So now, our God, the great and mighty and awesome God who keeps His gracious covenant, do not view lightly all the hardship that has come upon us, and upon our kings and leaders, our priests and prophets, our ancestors and all Your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.
public_domain_references.web: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.
public_domain_references.asv: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and lovingkindness, let not all the travail seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
public_domain_references.brenton: And now, O our God, the powerful, the great, the mighty, and the terrible, keeping thy covenant and thy mercy, let not all the trouble seem little in thy sight which has come upon us, and our kings, and our princes, and our priests, and our prophets, and our fathers, and upon all thy people, from the days of the kings of Assur even to this day.

pob.text: Yet you are righteous in all that has come upon us[a], for you have acted faithfully, but we have acted wickedly.

spob.text: Yet in everything that has happened to us, you are righteous, for you have acted faithfully, but we have acted wickedly.

public_domain_references.bsb: You are just in all that has befallen us, because You have acted faithfully, while we have acted wickedly.
public_domain_references.web: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.
public_domain_references.asv: Howbeit thou art just in all that is come upon us; for thou hast dealt truly, but we have done wickedly;
public_domain_references.kjv: Howbeit thou [art] just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
public_domain_references.brenton: But thou [art] righteous in all the things that come upon us; for thou hast wrought faithfully, but we have greatly sinned.

pob.text: Even our kings[a], our officials, our priests, and our fathers did not keep your law[c][b], and they did not listen to your commandments and your testimonies with which you warned them.

spob.text: Even our kings, officials, priests, and fathers[a] did not obey your law. They paid no attention to your commandments and to the covenant testimonies through which you warned them.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Our kings and leaders and priests and fathers did not obey Your law or listen to Your commandments and warnings that You gave them.
public_domain_references.web: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.
public_domain_references.asv: neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies wherewith thou didst testify against them.
public_domain_references.kjv: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
public_domain_references.brenton: And our kings, and our princes, and our priests, and our fathers, have not performed thy law, and have not given heed to thy commandments, and [have not kept] thy testimonies which thou didst testify to them.

pob.text: Even in their kingdom[a], and amid your great goodness that you gave them, and in the broad and fertile land that you set before them[d][c][b], they did not serve you and did not turn from their evil deeds.

spob.text: They had their own kingdom and received your great goodness. You set a spacious, fertile land before them. Even so, they did not serve you[a] or turn away from their evil deeds.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: For even while they were in their kingdom, with the abundant goodness that You had given them, and in the spacious and fertile land that You had set before them, they would not serve You or turn from their wicked ways.
public_domain_references.web: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.
public_domain_references.asv: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
public_domain_references.kjv: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they did not serve thee in thy kingdom, and in thy great goodness which thou gavest to them, and in the large and fat land which thou didst furnish before them, and they turned not from their evil devices.

pob.text: Look[a], today we are slaves; and in the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good things, look[c][b], we are slaves on it.
